#!/bin/bash
#MISE description="Update a Git repository's default branch with latest upstream changes"
#MISE dir="{{cwd}}"

set -euo pipefail
shopt -s extglob

if [[ ! -d .git ]]; then
  echo "This task must be run from the root of a Git repository."
  exit 1
fi

if ! git diff --quiet HEAD; then
  echo "Pending changes detected. Please first commit or revert your changes before running this task."
  exit 1
fi

default_branch="$(basename "$(git symbolic-ref refs/remotes/origin/HEAD)")"
mapfile -t remotes < <(git remote)

git switch "${default_branch}"

for remote in "${remotes[@]}"; do
  git fetch "${remote}"
  git remote update --prune "${remote}"
  if [[ "${remote}" == @(origin|upstream) ]]; then
    git rebase "${remote}/${default_branch}"
  fi
done

[[ " ${remotes[*]} " =~ " origin " ]] && git push --force origin
